svg.title: Lumentree Local onboarding overview
svg.desc: High-level setup flow from ESP32 flashing to Home Assistant pairing and normal telemetry polling.
svg.text: Lumentree Local: First-Time Setup Overview
Recommended path for a new user: ESP32 Wi-Fi onboarding, BLE selection, token claim, then Home Assistant polling.
Flash ESP32 bridge firmware
Use the matching ESP32 firmware for the Lumentree bridge.
This public repo is only the Home Assistant integration.
Join Wi-Fi in AP mode
Connect to the ESP32 temporary AP and enter only Wi-Fi credentials.
After reboot, AP mode turns off and the ESP32 joins your LAN.
Open the ESP32 local portal
Preferred URL: http://lumentree-xxxx.local
If .local does not resolve, use the ESP32 LAN IP from your router.
The portal is where the user scans BLE, selects the inverter, and creates pairing tokens.
Scan BLE and choose inverter
Run BLE scan in the portal and select the correct inverter candidate.
The Device ID entered later in Home Assistant must match this choice.
If more than one inverter exists, this is the step that decides the binding.
Generate pairing tokens
Create a required read pairing token.
Optionally create a write pairing token for guarded direct changes.
Tokens are shown in uppercase for clarity, but they are not case-sensitive.
Add integration in Home Assistant
Enter Device ID and the read token. Add the write token only if needed.
Home Assistant claims long-lived grant tokens and starts normal polling.
Without a valid read token, setup is rejected.
Result: Home Assistant reads telemetry through a read grant. Write access remains separate and optional.
